The primary visual feature is a continuous flow of bright, flowing light streaks that crisscross the screen, conveying a deep sense of constant movement and energy. When multiple streaks intersect, they momentarily coalesce into sharper, defined geometric forms, such as glowing points and angular lines, before dissolving back into the flowing abstraction of the metropolis.
